subject: Sponsors behind the accounts you rank
body:
Beyond coverage, the commercial read is who is already paying for the audience: a sponsor page carries its monthly placement history, the publications it runs in, and the sponsors sharing inventory with it.

An account can then be scored on two axes, how much editorial attention it gets and how much of that attention is bought.

Both are one call per account. I can send a sample keyed by domain with the sponsor side joined.
